title: Can / May / Be able to
summary: Use can for ability and informal permission, may for more formal permission, and be able to when another tense is needed.

explanation.en: Can expresses ability and common permission. May can ask or give permission more formally. Be able to is useful when can has no suitable tense.
explanation.ru: Can выражает умение и обычное разрешение, may — более формальное разрешение, be able to используется, когда нужна другая временная форма.

examples.en: I'll be able to help tomorrow.

commonMistakes.note: Use the base verb without to after can.
